parts.name: PreviewCardTrigger
parts.description: Spread on the link the card previews. It opens the card on hover and keyboard focus, after the delay.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on the link (or focus stays on it) before the card opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves the link and the card before it closes, in ms.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the link it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the link it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between link and card, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: PreviewCardArrow
parts.description: Spread on an element inside the popup: it is placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger, and carries the popup's `data-side`. The shape (a rotated square, an SVG) is the stylesheet's.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
